messages:
mia-ramirez: Heads-up: Northstar inbound RFI + ask to run a 2-week POC. Key asks: EU data residency, customer-managed HSM/KMS (they mentioned CloudHSM), dedicated GPU pool, and perf target p95 <120ms @16k context. They also want reserved vs burst pricing bands and a capability matrix. Need a coordinated RFI + attachments by EOD tomorrow.
liam-m: Copy. Who can own the HSM/KMS write-up? We should say Private supports customer-managed keys and include CloudHSM example.
andrew-eng: I'll draft the KMS/HSM section. Clarify: they want vendor-specific wording or equivalence?
terra-cs: Northstar wrote CloudHSM but said "vendor flexibility ok if FIPS 140-2 L3 equivalent." I'll capture that.
mia-ramirez: Good. Include note about export controls, data segregation, and audit log exportability.
jason-pm: Ill take the capability matrix and the POC runbook. Can someone paste the short matrix snippet to adapt?
andrew-eng: Quick matrix (pasteable):

Feature | Hosted API | Dedicated | Private (VPC)
---|---|---|---
EU data residency | EU region (shared infra)* | Reserved in customer region | Full customer-controlled tenancy
Customer-managed KMS/HSM | No | BYOK options in some configs | Yes (CloudHSM / on-prem HSM)
Dedicated GPU pools | No | Yes (reserved) | Yes (on-prem / dedicated)
Latency SLO | Best-effort | SLA-backed p95 | Configurable per deployment
Operational control | Redwood-managed | Isolated Redwood ops | Customer-managed controls

mia-ramirez: Add a footnote: "*Hosted EU region uses shared hardware; for strict tenancy choose Dedicated or Private."
liam-m: For pricing: can we provide anonymized bands: Reserved: $<committed_band>/GPU-month; Burst: $<on_demand>/GPU-hour. I'll anonymize numbers before sending.
jason-pm: Runbook items: allocation window for dedicated pool, onboarding checklist, sample dataset requirements, acceptance criteria (perf + quality checks), rollback plan. I'll draft and include a short perf test script.
andrew-eng: Perf command for runbook:
```bash
./benchmark_client --model redwood-v2 --context 16384 --concurrency 8 --percentile 95
```
security-bot: Security notes: SOC2 Type II available, ISO27001 in progress, recent pentest Jan 2025. Support for CloudHSM and audit log exports documented.
terra-cs: I'll request NDA amendment and sample dataset from Northstar, confirm timeline (they want week-of-Apr-8 start). Also ask them for network dry-run time.
mia-ramirez: Assignments: Andrew -> KMS/HSM write-up + perf snippets. Jason -> capability_matrix.csv + poc_runbook.md + attachments list. Liam -> pricing bands (anonymized). Terra -> legal/NDA + dataset coord. I'll compile and submit tomorrow EOD if we stay on schedule. :thumbsup:
